author: harrier_studio
title: Harrier Studio hiring illustrators and comic artists
content: HARRIER STUDIO IS HIRING! Open positions: Illustrator (Full Stage), Sketch Artist (Drafter), Line Artist, Colorist, Compositor, Storyboard Artist, Styling Artist, Typesetter. Looking for people who are serious, consistent, and can work with a team. Send CV and portfolio to harrierstdrecruitment@gmail.com (Subject: Name – Position – CV & Portofolio). Open until all positions are filled.

author: alex.r.gehringer
title: Head of Illustration seeking artists for publishing covers
content: Inbox is now open for queries and portfolio submissions. Artists: As newly appointed Head of Illustration, I’m on the hunt for incredible talent for children’s publishing, YA and adult covers, adult lifestyle and more. Send your portfolio and any concept decks to my inbox. Human work only. AI is not welcome. Contact via Instagram inbox.
